Seasonal Holiday Photo Collection

Collect and save all the memories throughout the seasons - from Christmas, Halloween, Easter, NYE, and Thanksgiving.

It’s Holiday Photo Collection Made Easy!

Create My Gallery
See How It Works
NO GUEST REGISTRATION +

NO APP TO DOWNLOAD

With GUESTPIX™ there’s no need to ask family to download a photo sharing app or to register!

A GUESTPIX™ QR code / private link is how you and your family add the best photos, videos and guestbook messages. Everyone can instantly enjoy the memories and you can download everything in full resolution.

2 mins to set up, it's so easy!

How It Works

It's so easy - only takes 2 mins to get started.

CREATE YOUR EVENT
Create your private event gallery in minutes. 

GUESTS SCAN QR CODE / TAP PRIVATE LINK
No guest registration required.

GUESTS UPLOAD
Guests add their name and upload photos, videos and messages. All media is labelled with your guests’ name.  

ENJOY
Everything is saved in one live, organized gallery that everyone will enjoy both during & after your event. 

DOWNLOAD IN FULL RESOLUTION
Your gallery can be downloaded in a full resolution zip.

FUN FEATURES – HIGH CUSTOMIZATION
Live Slideshow, Private Social Interactions, Digital Invitations & RSVP, Design Themes, Multi-Lingual & More!

Pricing

GUESTPIX™ makes it easy for you to capture the holiday season. Preserve your memories your way, no hashtags required.

LOVED & USED FOR

CHRISTMAS DAY
NEW YEARS EVE
EASTER CELEBRATIONS
HALLOWEEN
THANKSGIVING
SECRET SANTA
CHRISTMAS & NYE PARTIES

Empowering You To See All The Memories

You’ll love receiving the best moments from family, friends, or guests as they upload them to your digital gallery.

It will be filled with memorable photos and videos that capture the spirit of your holiday party, creating lasting memories for everyone to treasure.

You’ll find yourself checking the gallery frequently as new moments are added. When you’re ready, you can download the entire gallery in full resolution with just one click.

Fun Holiday Party Ideas with GUESTPIX™

GAME

I SPY... GAME

Bring a playful twist to your holiday party with a game of I Spy! Print the cards, invite guests to snap photos, and upload them to your GUESTPIX™ gallery. A Scavenger Hunt is also a fun twist that everyone will love. Customizable holiday themed QR code print templates are included in every purchase.

ENTERTAINMENT

LIVE SLIDESHOW

Enjoy watching all the photos and videos from your gallery displayed on the big screen! Simply activate the slideshow setting so everyone can enjoy the best moments throughout the night in the background.
TIP: Designate someone to actively take photos throughout the event and add them to the gallery so they are displayed in real-time.

FREE Bonus: Editable Holiday QR Code Canva Templates Included

With every GUESTPIX™ purchase, you’ll receive access to our amazing range of 180+ print templates! Add your GUESTPIX™ QR code to mini take-home cards, table cards or your welcome sign as a reminder for guests to share their photos and videos. 

Browse a few from our range – all completely customizable.

Simple, one-time pricing for digital invitations, RSVP tracking and private photo sharing galleries.

From Easter brunch to Christmas Day, capture the magic of the holiday season with GUESTPIX™.

More About GUESTPIX™ Christmas Parties

The holiday season is all about celebrating and choosing the right Christmas themes can make any gathering feel extra special. Whether you’re planning a cozy family get-together or a large company event, there are countless Christmas holiday themes to suit every occasion. From classic winter wonderlands to fun, modern takes like “Ugly Sweater” or “Santa’s Workshop,” the right theme sets the mood for a memorable time.

With every GUESTPIX™ purchase, you will receive access to 50+ editable Canva templates. And no holiday gathering is complete without the perfect Christmas party invitations to get everyone excited. Whether hosting a small family dinner or a grand corporate event, a well-designed invite adds a personal touch. Many businesses now use a Christmas QR code on their invitations, making it easy for guests to upload and share photos from the celebration. It’s a simple yet effective way to keep everything organized and connected.

Games are a must for any holiday celebration! Whether you’re looking for holiday games to play with friends and family or planning office Christmas party games to bring some fun to the workplace, interactive activities help keep the festive spirit alive. From trivia and gift exchanges to team challenges and scavenger hunts, the right games can turn any holiday gathering into an unforgettable experience.

For businesses and teams, finding unique company Christmas party ideas is key to throwing a celebration that employees will actually enjoy. Whether it’s a themed dinner, a virtual holiday party, or a charity-driven event, creating a fun and engaging atmosphere fosters team bonding and holiday cheer. If you’re planning a work Xmas do, incorporating photo-sharing platforms like GUESTPIX™ or QR code-based activities can enhance the experience and make it easy to capture and share memories.

Family gatherings during the holidays wouldn’t be the same without festive photos. If you’re looking for family Christmas photo ideas, consider themed outfits, outdoor winter settings, or cozy at-home snapshots in front of the Christmas tree. Whether formal or fun, holiday photos captured with GUESTPIX™ are a great way to preserve memories and share the joy of the season.

No matter how you celebrate, thoughtful planning and creative ideas help make every holiday gathering special. From invitations and games to memorable photos, bringing people together is what the season is all about!
